```{r init}
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

SITES <- params$SITES
PATH <- params$DROPBOX

# User can specify groups of synoptic sites: CB or LE
if(SITES == "CB") {
  SITES <- c("SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW")
} else if(SITES == "LE") {
  SITES <- c("PTR", "CRC", "OWC")
}

# Well dimensions, for computing water level below surface
# This file, and the following code, are from the sensor data pipeline
WELL_DIMS <- readr::read_csv("ancillary-data/well_dimensions.csv",
                             comment = "#",
                             col_types = "ccccddcddddd")
WELL_DIMS$ground_to_sensor_cm <-
    with(WELL_DIMS, ring_to_pressure_sensor_cm -
             (well_top_to_ground_cm - bolt_to_cap_cm))
# TEMPEST trolls were installed differently; 2 parameters instead of 3
tmp <- WELL_DIMS$Site == "TMP"
WELL_DIMS$ground_to_sensor_cm[tmp] <- WELL_DIMS$Bolt_to_sensor_depth_cm[tmp] + WELL_DIMS$Bolt_to_ground_cm[tmp]

WELL_DIMS <- WELL_DIMS[c("Site", "Plot", "Instrument_ID", "ground_to_sensor_cm")]

```

Sites: `r paste(SITES, collapse = ", ")`

Data path: `r PATH`

```{r helper-functions}
#| include: false

no_data_check <- function(x, what) {
  message("Total: ", nrow(x), " data rows")
  if(nrow(x) == 0) {
    cat('::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}',
        '## No Data',
        '',
        paste('No data files were found for', what),
        '',
        ':::', sep = "\n")
  }
}

# Read a raw datalogger file. This is copied from the sensor data pipeline code
read_datalogger_file <- function(filename, quiet = FALSE, ...) {

    # Parse line one to extract logger and table names
    dat <- read_lines(filename)
    message("\t- ", basename(filename), " (", length(dat)-4, " rows)")
    header_split <- strsplit(dat[1], ",")[[1]]
    header_split <- gsub("\"", "", header_split) # remove quotation marks
    format_name <- header_split[1] # first field of row 1
    logger_name <- header_split[2] # second field of row 1
    table_name <- header_split[length(header_split)]

    x <- read_csv(I(dat[-c(1, 3, 4)]), show_col_types = FALSE)
    info <- tibble(Logger = rep(logger_name, nrow(x)),
                   Table = rep(table_name, nrow(x)),
                   Format = rep(format_name, nrow(x)))
    as_tibble(cbind(info, x))
}

read_files <- function(type, sitelist = SITES, path = PATH) {
  
  # Loop through the sites and load files
  sitedat <- list()
  for(site in sitelist) {
    # Figure out where this site's files are
    if(site %in% c("PTR", "CRC", "OWC", "SWH", "GWI", "MSM", "GCW", "DLG")) {
      SUBPATH <- "COMPASS_PNNL_Data"
      CURRENT <- "current_data"
    } else if(site %in% c("TMP")) {
      SUBPATH <- "TEMPEST_PNNL_Data"
      CURRENT <- "Current_data" # you're killing me, Roy
    } else {
      stop("Unknown site: ", site)
    }
    
    files <- list.files(file.path(path, SUBPATH, CURRENT), 
                        pattern = paste0("_", site, "_.*_", type),
                        full.names = TRUE)
    filetext <- if_else(length(files) == 1, " file", " files")
    message(site, ": found ", length(files), filetext)
    
    x <- lapply(files, read_datalogger_file)
    sitedat[[site]] <- bind_rows(x)
  }
  bind_rows(sitedat, .id = "Site")
}

# Calculate the groundwater level below surface
# This code is copied straight from the sensor data pipeline
`CALC_DERIVED_gw-wl-below-surface` <- function(gw_density, gw_pressure, Site, Plot, Instrument_ID) {
    # The two data frames passed in should *normally* have the
    # exact same dimensions and ordering, since they're linked
    # AquaTROLL data from the same site and plot
    gw_density <- x$`gw-density`$Value
    gw_pressure <- x$`gw-pressure`$Value

    temp <- merge(x$`gw-density`,
                  WELL_DIMS,
                  by = c("Site", "Plot", "Instrument_ID"),
                  all.x = TRUE)
    ground_to_sensor_cm <- temp$ground_to_sensor_cm

    if(length(ground_to_sensor_cm) > length(gw_pressure)) {
        stop("Wrong data lengths, probably because the merge of WELL_DIMS matched multiple lines")
    }
#    if(all(is.na(ground_to_sensor_cm))) browser()

    # This follows Peter Regier's code, and Fausto M-S's logic
    density_gcm3_cor <- ifelse(gw_density >= 0.98 & gw_density <= 1.05, gw_density, 1)
    pressure_mbar <- ifelse(gw_pressure == -99999, 0, gw_pressure)
    pressurehead_m <- (pressure_mbar * 100) / (density_gcm3_cor * 1000 * 9.80665)

    # Pick one of our input data frames, overwrite its Value column,
    # and return it. The calling code in L2.qmd will take care of changing
    # the research_name and Type columns
    x$`gw-density`$Value <- round(pressurehead_m - (ground_to_sensor_cm / 100), 4)
    return(x$`gw-density`)
}


statname_separation <- function(x) {
  PLOT_FACTOR_LEVELS <- c("C", "F", "S", "UP", "TR", "WTE", "W")
  x %>% 
    # the GCW files' Statename column is slightly different format, which
    # is why we need the extra="drop" parameter
    separate(Statname, into = c("X", "Site_DL", "Plot"), extra = "drop") %>% 
    select(-X) %>% 
    mutate(Plot = factor(Plot, levels = PLOT_FACTOR_LEVELS))
}
pivotstep <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    select(-Format, -RECORD) %>% 
    pivot_longer(-1:-6) %>% 
    filter(name != "BattV_Avg") # we probably don't care about this
}
```

# Sapflow

```{r sf-read}
#| output: "asis"
sf <- read_files("Sapflow")
no_data_check(sf, "Sapflow")
```

```{r sf-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
if(nrow(sf) > 0) {
  sf %>% 
    pivotstep() %>% 
    # parse out site and plot info
    statname_separation() %>% 
    mutate(port = gsub("DiffVolt._Avg\\(", "", name),
           port = as.integer(gsub(")", "", port)),
           port = as.factor(port)) -> 
    sf_long
  
  p <- ggplot(sf_long, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = port)) +
    facet_grid(Site ~ Plot) +
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)
  print(p + ggtitle("Sapflow (all data)"))
  
  if(any(sf_long$value < 0) || any(sf_long$value > 1)) {
    print(p + ylim(c(0, 1)) + ggtitle("Sapflow (in-range data only)"))
  }
}
```

```{r sf-table}
if(nrow(sf) > 0) {
  sf_long %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_PB = paste(Plot, PB, sep = "-")) %>% 
    group_by(Site, Plot_PB, port) %>%
    summarise(value = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "Plot_PB", values_fill = 0) %>% 
    knitr::kable()
}
```

# TEROS

```{r teros-read}
#| output: "asis"
teros <- read_files("Teros") 
no_data_check(teros, "TEROS")
```

```{r teros-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
if(nrow(teros) > 0) {
  teros %>% 
    pivotstep() %>% 
    # parse out site and plot info
    statname_separation() %>% 
    mutate(name = gsub("Teros.\\(", "", name),
           name = gsub(")", "", name)) %>% 
    separate(name, into = c("port", "sensor"), convert = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(sensor_name = case_when(
      sensor == "1" ~ "EC",
      sensor == "2" ~ "T",
      sensor == "3" ~ "VWC"
    )) -> 
    teros_long
  
  for(sn in unique(teros_long$sensor_name)) {
    teros_sn <- filter(teros_long, sensor_name == sn)
    p <- ggplot(teros_sn, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = port)) +
      facet_grid(Site ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
      ggtitle(sn)
    print(p)
  }
}
```

```{r teros-table}
if(nrow(teros) > 0) {
  teros_long %>%

    mutate(Plot_PB = paste(Plot, PB, sep = "-")) %>%

    summarise(value = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "Plot_PB", values_fill = 0) %>%

}
```

# AquaTROLL

```{r troll-read}
#| output: "asis"
troll <- read_files("WaterLevel")
no_data_check(troll, "AquaTROLL")
```

```{r troll-plots}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
if(nrow(troll) > 0) {
  troll %>% 
    select(-starts_with("Aquatroll")) %>% # remove text column
    pivotstep() %>% 
    # NA value is -99999.00
    mutate(value = if_else(value == -99999, NA_real_, value)) %>% 
    # parse out site and plot info
    statname_separation() %>% 
    mutate(Instrument_ID = substr(name, nchar(name), nchar(name)),
           name = substr(name, 1, nchar(name) - 1)) %>% 
    # compute water level
    left_join(WELL_DIMS, by = c("Site", "Plot", "Instrument_ID")) %>% 
    # TODO  
    # filter per SW: WL, temp, salinity, DO, and pH
    filter(name %in% c("Temperature600", "Salinity600", "RDO_concen600",
                       "pH600", "Water_Density600", "Pressure600")) ->
    troll_long
  
  # Compute water level. For each Site, Plot, and Instrument_ID, 
  # extract the pressure, density, and ground_to_sensor info (happily 
  # guaranteed to be same order and timestamps since from same instrument)
  troll_long %>% 
    filter(name %in% c("Water_Density600", "Pressure600"), !is.na(value)) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "name") %>% 
    # This follows Peter Regier's code, and Fausto M-S's logic
    mutate(density_gcm3_cor = if_else(Water_Density600 >= 0.98 & Water_Density600 <= 1.05, Water_Density600, 1),
           pressure_mbar = if_else(Pressure600 == -99999, 0, Pressure600),
           pressurehead_m = (pressure_mbar * 100) / (density_gcm3_cor * 1000 * 9.80665),
           water_level_cm = round(100 * pressurehead_m - ground_to_sensor_cm, 1)) %>% 
    select(Site, Plot, Instrument_ID, TIMESTAMP, water_level_cm) -> 
    wl
  
    # join is many-to-one: many names at a given timestamp
    troll_long %>% 
      left_join(wl, by = c("Site", "Plot", "Instrument_ID", "TIMESTAMP"), relationship = "many-to-one") ->
    troll_long
  
     p <- ggplot(troll_long, aes(TIMESTAMP, water_level_cm, color = water_level_cm < -ground_to_sensor_cm)) +
      facet_grid(Site ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
       ggtitle("water_level_cm") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
    print(p)
    
  for(nm in unique(troll_long$name)) {
    x <- filter(troll_long, name == nm)
    p <- ggplot(x, aes(TIMESTAMP, value, color = water_level_cm < -ground_to_sensor_cm)) +
      facet_grid(Site ~ Plot, scales = "free") +
      ggtitle(nm) +
      geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

```{r troll-table}
if(nrow(troll) > 0) {
  troll_long %>% 
    filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
    mutate(Plot_PB = paste(Plot, PB, sep = "-")) %>%

    summarise(value = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "Plot_PB", values_fill = 0) %>%
```
